title: Not Appropriate For Age Group Specified.
text: I was looking for a monthly book subscription for my granddaughter. I had read mixed reviews about this service so I had the first set sent to my home so I could tell for myself. I have to side with the people who said the books were not well-chosen for the specified audience. I picked 0-12 months. One book was a board book and it was about the nose. It was cute. The other two were not for a 6-month old. One was a "First Reader" with small peel off stickers to place in the book. The other was nursery rhymes, but more of the Grimm's variety. No rhyme, no meter, and one was about pulling off a guys legs. Definitely not age appropriate. I ended up just buying a bunch of books from Amazon with 10,000+ reviews, 4.8+ stars, and rated by customers on age group appropriateness. I ended up with a great list of well-known and loved books. Now I'll just send her some each month. It took a little longer and some research, but in the end I think it will be well worth it. Reading is too important to start them out with "just whatever". I want all the book spines to be worn and cracked and the pages falling out from how often it was read. Not used under a short leg on a bedside table to keep it from wobbling. :)
label: negative
